elements.label: EXAMPLE 3.4
elements.title: Example 3.4: Calculate the median pulse rate for this sample

steps: Order data from smallest to largest: 51, 59, 65, 68, 72, 76, 83, 88, 92, 94
Since number of data values is even (10), add the two middle values (72 and 76) and divide by 2

elements.summary: This example demonstrates how to calculate the median of a dataset with an even number of values by ordering the data and averaging the two middle values.
